G-g-g-g-g-ghostsss!!
Pelulu~, aye...No good, she's not waking up.\nThere's nothing we can do now.
Oh! Those are...I'm sure those are the garbs worn\nby high-ranking monks...They could be the missing\ntrainee monks...
C'mon, hurry up! Please don't drop her.\nThis way, this way!
I'm leaving them to you~!
It may be presumptuous of me to ask, but are you\nthe monks that were training in the Ruined Temple?
Exactly. As the three of us traveled around to\nappease the world in turmoil after the Cataclysm,\nwe discovered the Wind Ark in this valley...
But then, we encountered some monsters that we'd\nnever seen before...
As we assumed the monsters were going to steal the\nark, we risked ourselves to repel them and protect\nthe ark by creating a barrier around it...
Oh no...
There's no need for sorrow. We decided to shield\nthe divine property voluntarily...Since then there\nhad been no attacks by monsters for a long time,
however, recently some creatures thought to be\nmonsters or their kin started to appear frequently\nand roam around here with evil spirits...
So they were the disturbing presence that I sensed\nwhen I got to this area and the monsters that\nattacked me...
They're gradually accumulating their power and we\ndon't know when they'll come back. When that time\ncomes, we may not be strong enough to stop them...
You explained the whole situation to the Trainee\nBonze Spirit and told him that they are called\nCoenubias and came from another world.
You told him the only way to beat them is to go to\ntheir stronghold and you ask him to remove the\nbarrier as you need to get the Wind Ark to move...
Hmm...Is that really what is happening now?!\nThat is so unbelievable...
But if that's true, we can remove the barrier,\nhowever, as soon as we remove it, evil spirits\nwill flock around the ark.
We need to make sure that you are capable of\nrepelling them...
So you will remove the barrier if we could defeat\nyou...Fine then...
We've been staying here as we wanted to protect\nthe god's ark, but now we've found someone we can\nrely on. Time for us to head to the Dark Realm...
Don't let your guard down even when you can't see\nthe enemy...Keep that in mind...
What was the meaning behind the Trainee Bonze's\nwords?
Now that I know what happened to the trainee\nbonzes, I'll return to the temple to hold a\nmemorial service to commemorate their virtues.
I'll leave the Wind Ark to you and please do what\nyou need to do with it. Take care...
T-the ghosts are gone, right...?\nPhew, what a relief...
Pelulu, you're being too scared of ghosts!\nYou've gotta toughen up and be brave!
Grrrrr!! They're scary, I can't do anything about\nit!! Geez, where did you learn to speak like that?\nThat's so obnoxious and annoying, you know...
What are you doing? Let's hurry to find the\nark...What?! You already know where it is?!\nWell, stop bumming around and let's go then!
Let's check if we can get it to move!\nC'mon!!
Pelulu, don't walk alone or you'll see ghosts~!
Shut up!!
